name: Maneki
text: Hello? I can’t talk right now.

name: Maneki
text: I’ll never get a raise if I quit now.

name: Wife
text: I don’t care where you’ve been going at night, but I wish you wouldn’t lie.

name: Wife
text: What’s all that clanging in the background?

name: Wife
text: You do know, not long ago, an old woman died of exhaustion from gambling?

name: Wife
text: She was so obsessed, she stopped eating, and the only thing she drank was the beer they served.

name: Wife
text: It's no wonder she collapsed. I don’t know whether to say good riddance or poor thing.

name: Wife
text: Can’t say I remember. Do you know her?

name: Wife
text: Look, I just hope you’ll be safe. And please come home tonight...
